name: Codex CLI
invoke: spawn the `waypost-<role>` agent, or `codex exec "$(waypost agents show <role>) <target>"`

skills.notes: Scans `.agents/skills` from the working directory up to the repository root, plus `$HOME/.agents/skills`; invoked as `$skill-name`. There is no `.codex/skills`.

notes: Codex has project-level agents now: .codex/agents/<name>.toml with name, description and developer_instructions (the system prompt), plus optional model, model_reasoning_effort and sandbox_mode. `sandbox_mode = "read-only"` is emitted, which is the one place a harness enforces the roles' read-only contract rather than asking for it. The older ~/.codex/prompts custom prompts are deprecated by OpenAI in favour of skills, so waypost no longer writes them; project agents need no follow-up copy step, so this entry has no after_install. `model_reasoning_effort` uses `{effort}` through `roles.effort.map`, which only covers Codex's own documented values (low/medium/high) — deliberately not inventing an `xhigh` or similar tier no vendor doc names. Every shipped role is effort:max today, which this maps to "high"; revisit the map if Codex's own scale changes. On `detect`: AGENTS.md is kept deliberately, not by omission. A live session was measured on 2026-09-30 (codex-cli 0.159.2) and it creates no project-local .codex/ at all, while OpenAI's own docs/agents_md.md makes AGENTS.md the primary project instruction file discovered from the repository root — so in a real Codex project this path is often the only on-disk evidence there is. It is also the file all 21 entries read, so a project that keeps it for other tools is over-counted as a codex project; the cost is one extra `agents install`, and it is accepted deliberately rather than left undecided (see the setup-evidence ADR). The official docs page could not be fetched directly (learn.chatgpt.com returned 404 to the fetcher); the format is taken from a reference that cites it — check once against `codex --help`. Live evidence, 2026-09-30, codex-cli 0.159.2 (bundled at /Applications/ChatGPT.app/Contents/Resources/codex-cli/bin/codex, not on PATH): inside a real session in a repo with only a README, `setup` saw codex with no file marker at all, and a full `setup` wrote five .codex/agents/*.toml role files, put the routing block in .codex/AGENTS.md, and left doctor at 0 issue. Two caveats keep this entry at `documented` rather than `verified`. First, the install needed `--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox`, because codex's default workspace-write sandbox refuses to create .codex/ (EPERM) — that is codex's own policy, not a waypost defect, but it means the first run is not the plain one the runbook describes. Second, the whole loop the runbook verifies (draft, story, commit trailers reaching `Waypost-Harness: codex`) has not been run on codex yet; that is WP-14's open step. The `docs` URL is also still a third-party reference for the agent-TOML format, not a vendor page — the vendor's own AGENTS.md guide (https://developers.openai.com/codex/guides/agents-md) is what supports the `detect` decision recorded above, and the format citation should be replaced with one when the official subagent-agents page is reachable.
